description: The coordination beacon's live pulse, the same read as https://vealth.net/labor/beacon: the coordination moves of the last 24 hours and of all time (posted, claimed, proved, accepted, settled, summed; settled cash is one column, never the measure), the board's totals, coordination cases counted by stage, three lights (ecological wealth, cybersecurity, health: care, never treatment) and the four intakes (a sighting, a need, capacity, capital) with the first call for each. Counts only: no case, place, wallet or job id. A read that failed is null, never a guess. It announces the mechanism, never an ecological outcome. Free, keyless, read-only, cached 60 s.
name: beacon
title: The coordination beacon: how much coordination the board is doing, live
